Ciepło began in a shared kitchen.
Kuchnia jako miejsce spotkania: The kitchen as a meeting place
W miejscach noclegowych prowadzonych prz: In the accommodation run by the foundation, shared kitchens quickly became an important part of everyday life. People cooked Ukrainian dishes there using ingredients we bought. They had not planned to emigrate, often did not speak the language and had not yet found something to do.
Gotowanie dawało zajęcie i zbliżało ludz: Cooking gave people something to do and brought them closer together. It helped them feel a little more at home.
Pomysł na dalsze działanie: An idea for what came next
Mieliśmy środki na bieżące funkcjonowani: We had funding for the foundation’s day-to-day work and room to think more calmly about the future. Accommodation was still needed, but we no longer had to keep increasing the number of places. We also knew that donations would not last forever.
Pandemia się kończyła. Ludzie wracali do: The pandemic was coming to an end. People were returning to restaurants, and there were still vacant premises on the market. We decided to connect that opportunity with what we had seen in the shared kitchens.
Znaleźliśmy niemal gotowy lokal przy uli: We found an almost ready-to-use space at 15 Dietla Street in Kraków and a supportive landlord. With enormous commitment from Olena, who had found her passion in the restaurant business, and help from many supporters, we opened a restaurant.
Nazwaliśmy ją Ciepło. Chodziło o ukojeni: We called it Ciepło. It was about a sense of comfort and a place where people far from home, often against their original plans, could feel they belonged.
Serwujemy tradycyjną kuchnię ukraińską w: We serve traditional Ukrainian food with a contemporary interpretation. The interior draws on the culture of the Carpathians, which connects parts of Poland and Ukraine. It brings to mind tradition, rest and closeness.
Na ścianach prezentujemy prace młodych u: We display work by young Ukrainian artists on the walls. We have also organised activities to bring people together, build a community and help them get to know one another.
Relacje między Polakami a osobami przyby: Relations between Poles and people who have arrived from Ukraine can be strained. We want to make our own small contribution to easing those tensions. A shared table, art and everyday hospitality are ways of doing that which feel close to us.
Start restauracji sfinansowaliśmy pożycz: We financed the restaurant’s launch with a loan from the foundation. It was a risky venture. Many people who shared our mission helped get it started, and some of them were people we knew personally.
Restauracja osiągnęła próg rentowności i: The restaurant reached break-even and built a financial buffer. At the time of writing, we are starting to repay the loan. We want Ciepło to provide lasting financial support for the foundation’s work.
Jako prezes zarządu odpowiadam za biznes: As president of the management board, I am responsible for the business side of the venture. The team handles the restaurant’s day-to-day operations. There is a lot happening here, and it still gives us all energy.
